newsitem.title: USA: CompUSA has record third-quarter sales.
newsitem.headline: CompUSA has record third-quarter sales.

text.p: CompUSA Inc., one of the nation's largest computer store chains, said Wednesday its sales jumped 19.4 percent to a record $1.27 billion in the third quarter from $1.07 billion a year ago.
The Dallas-based company's comparable-store sales, measuring sales at stores that were also open a year ago, rose 5.6 percent in the quarter ended March 29.

"This marks our tenth consecutive quarter of positive comparable store sales, which is an outstanding accomplishment," said James Halpin, CompUSA's president and chief executive. "These excellent sales results reflect the strength of CompUSA's overall business."
For the first nine months of fiscal 1997, comparable-store sales were up 4.6 percent and net sales rose 22.3 percent, to $3.46 billion from $2.83 billion a year earlier.

CompUSA operates 123 Computer Superstores in 56 major metropolitan markets throughout the United States. It also operates PCs Compleat, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of CompUSA and a leading direct reseller of personal computers and peripherals.
Its stock rose 50 cents to $16.25 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
